static_traits.name: Lin Sha
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to talk with, but difficulty opening up about Loneliness and estrangement, friendships Relationship tension, feeling estranged from friends
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Tone neutral and steady, clear expression, fairly good cooperation; able to proactively describe feelings of being ignored and Loneliness, decreased motivation

basic_info.main_problem: I feel friends think my lifestyle is very boring, which makes me feel Loneliness and isolated.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to feel accepted and valued, able to get along with friends naturally without feeling like forcing them to be with me.

core_beliefs: I am not interesting (my lifestyle is very boring)

special_situations.event: Seeing friends gather or go out together without inviting oneself
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not participate in activities they like, they will find me boring, unwilling to be with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: More frequently initiates contact with friends, proposes low-intensity activities closer to one's own lifestyle to seek acceptance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They find me boring, do not want to be with me

special_situations.event: Friends not replying to one's messages in time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not respond in time, it shows I am not important to them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing message frequency, proactively suggesting activities to confirm the relationship
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are distancing from me, I am not important

special_situations.event: Noticing friends more frequently organizing party/outing-centered activities without one's participation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not participate in their preferred activities, it proves I am an uninteresting person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to propose different types of low-key activities hoping the other accepts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They always exclude me, because I am too boring

special_situations.event: After trying more contact and proposing different activities, still no improvement yet
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I tried and nothing changes, then the relationship will not improve
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces participation and motivation, reduces investment in activities she originally liked
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It seems there will be no change in the future either

core_conflict.wish: Desires to be accepted, valued by friends, and get along naturally
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being rejected and excluded, fearing oneself unimportant/unneeded
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected through cautious self-expression, seeking to please or lowering expectations

object_relations.object_representation: Distant friend group uninterested in oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes trying new small steps or strategies
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe 'I have tried everything without effect', holding negative Anticipation toward further attempts
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone calm but with a sense of powerlessness, repeating expressions like 'I have tried everything' 'seems useless', weakening openness to new plans.

manifestations: Friends often gathering without inviting oneself
Difficulty opening up to friends about feelings of Loneliness and being isolated
outcomes: Persistent Loneliness and sense of isolation

manifestations: Loses motivation for activities originally enjoyed (fitness, reading, cooking)
Having the thought 'if always Loneliness, what is the meaning of these activities'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Directly Interpreting friends' distancing as 'they find me boring' 'do not want to be with me'
Speculating others' negative views of oneself without evidence

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Overly self-attributing as 'not participating in their activities causing estrangement'
Difficulty opening up to friends about true feelings (Loneliness, being ignored)

positive_force: Willing to try small steps and behavioral experiments to test cognitions
Can proactively contact friends and propose activity suggestions
Has some social resources (still has friends to talk to)
negative_force: Thinking pattern biased toward mind reading, overgeneralization, and personalization
Difficulty expressing Loneliness and needs to friends, tending toward Silence and Self-denial
Decreased motivation, reducing participation in once-loved activities, further weakening connections

target_behavior.behavior: Strong feelings of being ignored under interpersonal rejection cues, reducing social and daily activity participation (sense of Loneliness and lack of drive)
antecedent: Seeing friends gather without inviting oneself yet
Friends not yet replying to messages in time
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting others' behaviors as negation of oneself (mind reading, overgeneralization, personalization), maintained by the core belief 'I am very boring/unimportant'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding further being rejected to protect self-esteem (emotional avoidance), while trying to gain confirmation through pleasing or more frequent contact
target_behavior.consequence: Further reduced social connections, worsened Loneliness; Motivation significantly declining for activities like fitness, reading, cooking
